summary: John's 1st cousin 4x removed; Dr. Joseph V. Connole, WWI Navy eye surgeon.
bio: Son of John F. Connole; born 1889; eye, ear, nose and throat specialist in Wilkes-Barre. Enlisted Oct 1917; U.S. Navy senior lieutenant in charge of eye work at the Philadelphia Navy Yard for two years.
